description.text: Starter Set Tera Type: Stellar Ceruledge ex, released on 30 August 2024 with Sylveon ex's: a ready-to-play 60-card deck around a new Ceruledge ex with the Stellar Tera type. Its Raging Amethyst does 280 damage by discarding all its Energy, which powers up Abyssal Flames, stronger for every Energy in the discard pile. Ho-Oh and Noctowl work with Tera Pokémon in play, and Tera Orb finds one. The deck introduced a new ACE SPEC, Brilliant Blender, which discards up to five cards from the deck. The box held damage counters, Poison and Burn markers, a coin, a playmat and a guide.
